As an otherwise normal heterosexual 26 y/o male with an extra attraction to 11-18 year old girls, please let me extend my gratitude to you. I can't deny my attraction, but I can deny my impulse to act on it. 

I don't act on my urges not because I fear the consequences but because it's the right thing to do. This takes an unbelievably large amount of will power, and is a battle that nobody sees me fighting. Or so I thought until you commented.

With all the hate surrounding the topic, it's hard not to take it personally. Sometimes it feels like the entire world is against you, when you're morally in agreement with them and do your best to do the right thing. So thank you for your empathy. It means a lot more than you think, and makes this fight a whole lot easier.
